mapper.sql: SELECT a.application_id AS applicationId, a.application_no AS applicationNo, a.requested_by_account_id AS accountId, a.status, a.active_slot AS activeSlot, c.client_id AS clientId, c.client_no AS clientNo, c.party_id AS partyId, p.party_type AS clientType, f.profile_id AS profileId, f.draft_application_id AS draftApplicationId, f.approved_time AS approvedTime, b.business_profile_id AS businessProfileId, a.create_time AS createdAt, a.update_time AS savedAt, a.jurisdiction_code AS jurisdictionCode, a.organization_type_code AS organizationTypeCode, a.schema_id AS schemaId, a.responsible_partner_id AS responsiblePartnerId, a.due_diligence_case_id AS dueDiligenceCaseId, a.review_due_time AS reviewDueTime, a.draft_revision AS draftRevision FROM t_client_application a JOIN t_client c ON c.client_id=a.client_id JOIN t_party p ON p.party_id=c.party_id LEFT JOIN t_party_profile f ON f.party_id=p.party_id AND f.current_slot=1 LEFT JOIN t_client_business_profile b ON b.client_id=c.client_id
mapper.select: WHERE a.requested_by_account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY a.active_slot DESC,a.application_id DESC LIMIT 21
WHERE a.application_id=#{applicationId} AND a.requested_by_account_id=#{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_client_application(application_id,application_no,client_id,requested_by_account_id, status,active_slot,qualification_type,application_type,jurisdiction_code,organization_type_code,schema_id,onboarding_code_id, responsible_partner_id,submission_round,create_time,update_time) SELECT #{applicationId},#{applicationNo},client_id,requested_by_account_id,'DRAFT',1,qualification_type,'ONBOARDING', #{terms.jurisdictionCode},#{terms.organizationTypeCode},#{terms.schemaId},#{terms.onboardingCodeId}, #{terms.responsiblePartnerId},0,#{now},#{now} FROM t_client_application WHERE application_id=#{rejectedId} AND status IN ('REJECTED','WITHDRAWN')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_client SET jurisdiction_code=#{terms.jurisdictionCode}, responsible_partner_id=#{terms.responsiblePartnerId},update_time=#{now} WHERE client_id=#{clientId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE t_party_profile SET draft_application_id=#{applicationId},update_time=#{now} WHERE draft_application_id=#{rejectedId} AND approved_time IS NULL AND current_slot=1
UPDATE t_party_relation SET client_application_id=#{applicationId},update_time=#{now} WHERE client_application_id=#{rejectedId} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT application_id FROM t_client_application WHERE requested_by_account_id=#{accountId} AND active_slot=1

SELECT p.profile_id AS profileId, i.given_name AS individualGivenName, i.middle_name AS individualMiddleName, i.family_name AS individualFamilyName, i.birth_date AS individualBirthDate, i.nationality_country AS individualNationalityCountry, i.residence_country AS individualResidenceCountry, i.birth_place AS individualBirthPlace, i.birth_country AS individualBirthCountry, i.gender AS individualGender, i.source_of_funds_code AS individualSourceOfFundsCode, i.pep_self_declared AS individualPepSelfDeclared, o.legal_name AS organizationLegalName, o.trade_name AS organizationTradeName, o.incorporation_country AS organizationIncorporationCountry, o.organization_type AS organizationOrganizationType, o.incorporation_date AS organizationIncorporationDate, o.registration_authority_code AS organizationRegistrationAuthorityCode, o.license_expiry_date AS organizationLicenseExpiryDate, o.listed_company AS organizationListedCompany, a.address_line1 AS addressAddressLine1, a.address_line2 AS addressAddressLine2, a.city AS addressCity, a.state_or_province AS addressStateOrProvince, a.postal_code AS addressPostalCode, a.country_code AS addressCountryCode, a.building_number AS addressBuildingNumber, a.additional_number AS addressAdditionalNumber, a.district AS addressDistrict, a.po_box AS addressPoBox, d.identifier_type AS identifierIdentifierType, d.issuing_country AS identifierIssuingCountry, d.identifier_vault_token AS identifierVaultToken, d.public_identifier_value AS identifierPublicValue, d.identifier_masked_value AS identifierMaskedValue, d.identifier_check_result AS identifierCheckResult, d.issue_date AS identifierIssueDate, d.expiry_date AS identifierExpiryDate, b.business_model_code AS businessBusinessModelCode, b.website_url AS businessWebsiteUrl, b.business_description AS businessBusinessDescription, b.expected_volume AS businessExpectedVolume, b.expected_ticket AS businessExpectedTicket, b.currency AS businessCurrency FROM t_party_profile p LEFT JOIN t_individual_profile i ON i.profile_id=p.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_organization_profile o ON o.profile_id=p.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_party_address a ON a.profile_id=p.profile_id AND a.address_type=#{addressType} LEFT JOIN t_party_profile_identifier d ON d.profile_id=p.profile_id JOIN t_client_business_profile b ON b.client_id=#{clientId} WHERE p.profile_id=#{profileId}
SELECT contact_type AS contactType,contact_vault_token AS token,contact_masked_value AS maskedValue FROM t_party_contact WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND contact_type IN ('EMAIL','PHONE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_party_profile_identifier WHERE profile_id=#{profileId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_party_profile_identifier SET identity_key_id=NULL,update_time=#{now} WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND identity_key_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_party_contact(contact_id,profile_id,contact_type,contact_vault_token,contact_masked_value,create_time,update_time) VALUES(#{id},#{profileId},#{contact.contactType},#{contact.token},#{contact.maskedValue},#{now},#{now}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE contact_vault_token=incoming.contact_vault_token, contact_masked_value=incoming.contact_masked_value,update_time=incoming.update_time
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_party_contact WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND contact_type=#{contactType}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_client_application SET update_time=#{now} WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND active_slot=1 AND status IN ('DRAFT','RETURNED')
UPDATE t_client_application SET draft_revision=draft_revision+1 WHERE application_id=#{applicationId} AND active_slot=1 AND status IN ('DRAFT','RETURNED')
UPDATE t_party_profile SET update_time=#{now} WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND approved_time IS NULL
